content: उपाकृत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Brought near; उपाकृतं शशमानं यदस्थात्प्रियं देवानामप्येतु पाथः <ls>Av. 2. 34. 2</ls>. .²2 Invited, called with प्रैष sentences. .²3 Killed at a sacrifice (an animal). .²4 Begun, commenced. .²5 Ominous, disastrous, calamitous. .²6 Consecrated with mantras; इति बालकमादाय सामर्ग्यजुरुपाकृतैः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 7. 14</ls>. .²7 Prepared, used for; यज्ञेषूपाकृतं विश्वं प्राहुरुत्तमसंज्ञितम् <ls>Mb. 12. 268. 22</ls>. .{@-तः@} .²1 A sacrificial animal killed during the recitation of prescribed prayers. .²2 A misfortune, portent. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Beginning, commencement. .²2 The performance of the usual rites (संस्कार) over the sacrificial animal. .²3 Invitation.
